description: This file declares the MediaPipelineService class, which implements the IMediaPipelineService interface for managing media pipeline sessions, including creation, destruction, loading media, attaching sources, controlling playback, and querying capabilities within a media server context.

classes.name: MediaPipelineService
classes.description: Implements media pipeline session management, including creation, destruction, media loading, source attachment, playback control, and capability queries.

methods.name: MediaPipelineService
methods.description: Constructor initializing the media pipeline service with required dependencies.

methods.name: ~MediaPipelineService
methods.description: Destructor for cleanup.

methods.name: createSession
methods.description: Creates a new media pipeline session with specified parameters.

methods.name: destroySession
methods.description: Destroys an existing media pipeline session.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads media into a session with specified MIME type and URL.

methods.name: attachSource
methods.description: Attaches a media source to a session.

methods.name: removeSource
methods.description: Removes a media source from a session.

methods.name: allSourcesAttached
methods.description: Checks if all sources are attached for a session.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Starts playback for a session.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses playback for a session.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops playback for a session.

methods.name: setPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets the playback rate for a session.

methods.name: setPosition
methods.description: Sets the playback position.

methods.name: getPosition
methods.description: Retrieves the current playback position.

methods.name: setVideoWindow
methods.description: Sets the video window dimensions.

methods.name: haveData
methods.description: Indicates if data is available for a session.

methods.name: renderFrame
methods.description: Renders a frame for a session.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Sets the volume for a session.

methods.name: getVolume
methods.description: Retrieves the current volume.

methods.name: setMute
methods.description: Mutes or unmutes the audio.

methods.name: getMute
methods.description: Checks if audio is muted.

methods.name: getSupportedMimeTypes
methods.description: Returns supported MIME types for a media source type.

methods.name: isMimeTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a MIME type is supported.

methods.name: clearMediaPipelines
methods.description: Clears all active media pipelines.
